name: @kiwa-lab/spec-kit
description: kiwa spec-driven development toolkit — classify specification items into 3 layers (formal-verifiable / runtime-testable / human-review-only) and emit paired spec files: specFormal.md (Lean-verifiable state machines and pure contracts) + specRuntime.md (side effects, integration, UX). Structurally prevents 'written but never verified' silent gaps。 The 際 (kiwa) between specification and verification is where quality is decided

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
